entries.body: Stage1: compute_invoice(lines,customer)->dict subtotal/discount/tax/total 2dp str; tax 10% all. Stage2: ValueError on empty lines/non-positive-int qty/negative price; bulk qty>=200 x0.88, >=50 x0.95. Stage3: tier discount gold 5% silver 2% else 0; CHANGED rounding: exact sub/disc/tax, round each half-even, total=rs-rd+rt. All in invoice/core.py (_validate,_bulk,_tier_rate,_tax_rate,_r). format_money stub unimplemented. Stage 3 implemented; check test result then advance.
